findings.description: Gift card used to cover the $8.34 price difference without verifying its balance, although policy requires 'If the user provides a gift card, it must have enough balance to cover the price difference'. get_user_details (which exposes balances) was never called before modify_pending_order_items.
findings.notes: Borderline: the modify succeeded, so the balance was empirically sufficient, but the verification obligation is on the agent per policy.

notes: Otherwise strong: authentication, single calls, correct variant identified (750ml glass black $54.85 IS the highest-priced available variant), correct $8.34 difference, explicit confirmation incl. one-time-modify warning.
